environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate task (task-def arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:123456789012:task-definition/api-signer:14) in private subnet (subnet-0f1e2d3c4b5a69780, no IGW route). Origin is fronted by CloudFront distribution E3KXYZ9A8B7C6D with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy oac-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 configured with signing behavior 'always' and origin type 'mediastore'. The ALB (internal, scheme=internal) security group sg-09f8e7d6c5b4a3210 has a SINGLE inbound rule: TCP 8080 from the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing, pl-3b927c52). Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has a cache behavior for /api/debug/* with viewer-request Lambda@Edge function (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:cf-auth-gate:7) that validates a custom HMAC-SHA256 token in the Authorization header against a rotating secret stored in Secrets Manager (arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:cf-debug-hmac-key-Rz4kQ1). Requests without valid token receive 403. The prefix list restriction means the origin ALB is unreachable from any IP outside CloudFront's edge network, and the Lambda@Edge function ensures only authenticated operators can reach debug endpoints through CloudFront.
